Evidence: Rahul Gandhi, the Congress Vice President, explicitly stated that Congress will not support the Third Front to form a government. He emphasized, 'We will not support any front,' during a campaign event. This statement was made in response to questions about the possibility of Congress supporting a Third Front government. Gandhi also expressed confidence that Congress would secure the required number of seats to form the government independently. His remarks came after comments from CPI(M) General Secretary Prakash Karat and claims from Samajwadi Party leaders regarding potential support from Congress for a Third Front government. (Sources 1, 2, and 3)
Justification: The retrieved evidence directly corroborates the claim made by Rahul Gandhi that Congress will not support the Third Front to form a government. Sources 1, 2, and 3 all report his clear statement, 'We will not support any front,' confirming the core assertion of the claim. Additionally, his confidence in securing enough seats further supports the assertion that Congress is not considering alliances with the Third Front.
